_comment: Router configuration for the Phase 1 comparison.
cost.gpu_seeds describes the cluster's hardware to the static cost model.
The built-in table does not know these parts well enough: keying on a GPU
generation hands a laptop part a desktop flagship's bandwidth, and a cost
model that cannot tell a strong node from a weak one has nothing left to
rank on but warmth — which is precisely the bias this project must not have.
These numbers are what an operator would write from a spec sheet, and they
are deliberately APPROXIMATE: each is within about 10% of the rate the
simulated node actually delivers, in both directions. Setting them exactly
would hand the cost model the answer and make the Phase 1 comparison
meaningless. Phase 2 is what removes the residual error, and it needs there
to be a residual error to remove.
